verification_vocabulary: As GRAPH-FORMAT.md and the settler-colonialism packet: bibliographic_metadata_checked = identity/edition checked in a catalogue or DOI record; supporting_page_checked = an abstract, contents page, publisher description or opening text was read for the specific point in `supports`; unverified = not cited.
